question: ______ are the vessels which carry blood away from the heart to various organs of the body.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arteries.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arteries are thick-walled blood vessels that carry oxygenated blood away from the heart to various organs of the body.**
 
• They have a **muscular wall **that **contracts and relaxes** to regulate blood pressure and flow.
